semantics.edge: All sequential logic uses positive clock edges per final sentence
semantics.load: Active high synchronous load copies data into q at the next positive edge, taking precedence over evolution
semantics.evolution: With load low each positive edge updates all cells simultaneously from the prior q; neighbour counts 0,1,4..8 give zero, 2 holds the cell, 3 gives one
semantics.mapping: Bit row*16+column; row 0 is q[15:0]; both coordinates wrap modulo 16
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified
semantics.initialization: No power-up value specified; no DUT initialization is added; check defined behavior after first load

verification.oracle: Independent procedural coordinate-offset traversal of original neighbour rules
verification.sampling: Drive on falling edge; verify unchanged output before rising edge and compare after NBA settling
verification.cases: zero, all alive, isolated cells, blocks, oscillators across wrap boundaries, every neighbour count for interior and corner cells, deterministic random multigeneration evolution, repeated loads
verification.timeout: Bounded simulation with fatal mismatches and final PASS marker

specification_ambiguities: Startup q is unspecified. Tests do not assert a defined startup value or evolution before initialization.
